ports.label: LAN
ports.notes: 10/100/1000 Base-T host control / configuration.

ports.label: POTS Line
ports.notes: Analog POTS telephone interface on RJ-11 (compliant with PSTN / PBX). Modeled as `analog-audio` since POTS carries voice as a baseband analog signal — no `pots`/`telephony` SignalType in src/types.ts.

ports.label: POTS Handset
ports.notes: Analog POTS telephone interface on RJ-11 (compliant with PSTN / PBX). Modeled as `analog-audio` since POTS carries voice as a baseband analog signal — no `pots`/`telephony` SignalType in src/types.ts.

ports.label: Dante / AES67 1
ports.notes: 1 Gbps Dante / AES67 audio network port (4-port internal switch).

ports.label: Dante / AES67 2
ports.notes: 1 Gbps Dante / AES67 audio network port (4-port internal switch).

ports.label: Dante / AES67 3
ports.notes: 1 Gbps Dante / AES67 audio network port (4-port internal switch).

ports.label: Dante / AES67 4
ports.notes: 1 Gbps Dante / AES67 audio network port (4-port internal switch).

ports.label: Digital I/O 1
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output. 6-pole captive screw shared with adjacent audio inputs (per-channel modeled).

ports.label: Digital I/O 2
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output. 6-pole captive screw shared with adjacent audio inputs (per-channel modeled).

ports.label: Digital I/O 3
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output. 6-pole captive screw shared with adjacent audio inputs (per-channel modeled).

ports.label: Digital I/O 4
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output. 6-pole captive screw shared with adjacent audio inputs (per-channel modeled).

ports.label: RS-232
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 host control on a 3-pole 3.5mm captive screw (38400 baud default).

ports.label: EXP
ports.notes: Proprietary 16×16 bidirectional digital audio expansion port over shielded CAT6 (24-bit / 48 kHz uncompressed). Used to link two DMP units or link to a DTP CrossPoint matrix. Mapped to `aes` SignalType per session 5 XMP 240 convention (no `extron-exp` SignalType in src/types.ts).

ports.label: USB Audio (Rear)
ports.notes: Rear-panel USB Mini-B for USB audio bridge (USB 2.0 high-speed). Up to 4 channels of digital audio in/out.

ports.label: USB Config (Front)
ports.notes: Front-panel USB Mini-B for DSP Configurator / PCS configuration (USB 2.0).

ports.label: Power
ports.notes: Internal 100-240 VAC PSU (IEC mains).
